name: 3 MVA pad-mount transformer

sources.title: 10 CFR 431.196 energy conservation standards for distribution transformers
EEPower: transformer supply chain woes persist (Wood Mackenzie lead-time survey)

summary: Medium-voltage to 415 V liquid-immersed pad-mount transformer of 3 MVA; often on the critical path.

ratingVa.note: Class rating; a common unit substation size feeding about 2.5 MW of IT at 0.95 power factor with headroom.

efficiency.note: US DOE 2016 minimum for 2500 kVA three-phase liquid-immersed units is 99.53 % at 50 % load; full-load efficiency is somewhat lower.

capexUsd.note: Judgment: about 60 USD/kVA after the 2021–2024 price rises, equipment only.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Wood Mackenzie survey: distribution transformer lead times averaged about 30 weeks in Q2 2025, down from over 100 weeks in 2023, while three-phase pad-mount units kept rising; 52 weeks is a planning value.
